name: LiveAgent
oneLiner: All-in-one help desk from Quality Unit with live chat, ticketing, a built-in call center, social channels and an AI chatbot.
bestFor: Small and mid-size teams that want chat, email, phone and social support plus AI in one affordable help desk.

updates.text: LiveAgent rolled out its AI Chatbot (powered by FlowHunt, also built by Quality Unit) in Q1 2025; it runs from the existing chat button with no separate widget.
LiveAgent announced an AI Answer Generator in its August 2025 monthly update.

features: Universal inbox for email, live chat, phone and social messages
Built-in call center with IVR, call routing and call recording
AI Chatbot that answers from your content and detects the customer's language
AI Answer Improver writing assistant for agents
Automation rules, ticket distribution and SLAs

pricing.text: Starter from $15/agent/month billed annually (promotional $11 until November 22, 2026); Team $29, Business $49 per agent/month regular annual prices; Enterprise flat $3,199/month billed annually for 80 agents. Free trial; no free plan per third-party sources.

notes: liveagent.com could not be fetched; pricing from search snippets of the pricing page (tier names changed from Small/Medium/Large to Starter/Team/Business). Original said 'Free plan available' — CostBench says no free plan as of August 2026, so dropped. Dropped 'fastest live chat widget' claim (unverifiable). AI Answer Generator date is from the 2025 wrap-up summary of the August 2025 update.
